notes: Capital One's April 14, 2026 announcement explicitly states that Spark Miles Select will now be known as VentureOne Business. This record preserves the predecessor brand and its historical terms; the announcement does not establish an exact withdrawal date. The former generic credit-card catalog source did not document this predecessor or its rebrand. No successor artwork is used. Historical artwork provenance (checked 2026-10-21): the retained 2020-01-01 archive of the official Capital One Spark Miles Select product page lists the product "Spark® Miles Select" (brand code SPARKMILESSELECT) with the image Spark-Miles-Select.png. The linked image resolves to a 2019-12-04 archive capture of that Capital One-hosted asset and was visually inspected as the blue Spark Business card; the face does not print the product name or network mark, so the product-data association is the evidence. It is a 384x242 historical image documenting the predecessor brand as marketed at that date; it is not evidence of lifecycle or the financial fields, which were not reverified in this artwork-only update.
